prompt: pixel art, single centered female knight, red cape, sword in right hand, shield in left hand, full body, plain background
negative_prompt: multiple characters, sprite sheet, photorealistic, smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, blur
expected_traits: Exactly one main knight sprite is present.
Sword and shield are both visible in correct hands.

prompt: pixel art, single mage sprite, purple robe, wooden staff, exactly two floating blue orbs, centered composition
negative_prompt: extra floating objects, sprite sheet, realistic render, smooth lighting, blur
expected_traits: Exactly two blue orbs are visible.
Purple robe and wooden staff are clear.
failure_checks: Orb count is not exactly two.
More than one main character appears.
Staff or robe attribute is missing.

prompt: pixel art, single gold coin inventory icon, crisp circular silhouette, limited yellow orange palette, plain background
negative_prompt: repeating pattern, tiled duplicates, realistic metal render, anti-aliasing, blur
expected_traits: One dominant coin icon is present.
Edge pixels are crisp and readable.
No dense repeating icon pattern appears.
failure_checks: Coin degenerates into repeated tiny dots.
Soft blurred edges on icon boundary.
Shape no longer reads as circular coin.

prompt: pixel art, single green slime monster, thick dark outline, flat interior shading, centered front view
